prompts.prompt: Create ONE square full-bleed background artwork for a cute playable cartoon livestream game. Use the attached seaside garden solely as a STYLE and CAMERA reference; build a genuinely different setting. Same premium softly hand-painted rounded 3D toy-diorama style, elevated front camera approximately 35 degrees down, moderate perspective, warm soft ambient contact shadows. CRITICAL GAME GEOMETRY: the lower 60% of the image is a broad FLAT EMPTY courtyard filling from x=7% to 96%, y=42% through the whole bottom edge. It must be uninterrupted continuous ground, with no raised platform, no board, no table, no floating island, no central props or markings. Ground must remain pale enough for pastel toy domino blocks to be clearly readable. Scenic buildings/plants/decor only along the top 40% and far side edges. No people, no animals except small ornamental sculptures, no characters, no bricks, no dominoes, no UI, no lettering, no logos, no watermark. Keep the cheerful charming high-quality game illustration detail of the reference. THEME: Sakura courtyard. A tiny cream-and-rose Japanese-inspired cottage with round windows on the upper left, pink cherry blossom trees and falling petals along the upper and outer sides, a small stone lantern upper right, soft blue spring sky. Broad empty warm ivory-peach sandy foreground. Pastel rose, mint, cream, peach. Do not reproduce the seaside cottage or whale watering can.
